message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of "TEMPO" magazine, dated 15-21 APRIL 2024. The composition features two stylized male caricatures sharing a single, large white miner’s safety helmet. The helmet includes a prominent silver headlamp mounted on its front. The man on the left has a tan complexion, a thick black mustache, and downcast eyes. The man on the right has a darker complexion, wide bulging eyes, and a furrowed brow. They are positioned closely together, facing forward.

The red "TEMPO" masthead is at the top. Large black text on the helmet reads "TAMBANG BAYAR UTANG." Below this, smaller black text mentions "Luhut Pandjaitan," "Bahlil Lahadalia," and "H.24." Other headlines at the top include "Pesantren Tak Berizin di Sekitar Kita H.64" and "Risiko Macet Obligasi Daerah H.74." The background is a soft blue-to-white gradient. In the bottom left corner, there is pricing information "RP 50.000," a barcode, and a QR code. The overall style uses smooth digital painting with dramatic lighting and shadows.
